description: A row turns bold, unread, only once its agent stops working in stock Shelley. The server runs in stock Shelley, with the conversation {{CONV_ID}}, which can message the user. Call "ready" has its agent message the user "Ready" and end its turn; call "delay" sends it a message its agent works on for 3 seconds. "The row" is ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"{{CONV_ID}}\"]", "the bold row" is ".conversation-item-unread[data-conversation-id=\"{{CONV_ID}}\"]", and "the title" is the row's ".conversation-title". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. The row should be visible. 3. Call "ready". 4. The bold row should become visible. 5. The title's computed font-weight should be "700". 6. Call "delay". 7. The row's ".working-indicator" should become visible. 8. There should be exactly 0 bold rows. 9. The title's computed font-weight must not be "700". 10. The row should come to hold exactly 0 ".working-indicator" elements (allow up to 15s). 11. The bold row should be visible. 12. The title's computed font-weight should be "700". 13. Click the row. 14. The row should come to have aria-current "page". 15. There should be exactly 0 bold rows. 16. The title's computed font-weight must not be "700".
